model_summary.objective: weighted complete system energy including leakage and idle tail
model_summary.coefficient_errors: outward interval rows; not solver arithmetic certification
model_summary.optimality_level: solver-reported only; external SAFE supplies a feasible upper bound

preprocessing.numeric_scope: fresh outward enclosure of retained physical choices; not old-matrix equivalence

option_support.scope: Necessary direct-edge and same-unit support only, relative to supplied options; no OPP/start equality, resource-pair support, thermal or optimization evaluation.

row_reuse.scope: per-model immutable values; rows and coefficient dictionaries remain distinct

construction.detail_scope: nested within thermal_conditional_rows; generic template details also nest in affine misses; never sum with parents
construction.component_scope: disjoint timed regions; inclusive includes nested observation; unfinished calls counted on exception unwind
construction.observation_cost_scope: callbacks including synchronous progress logging; budget checks excluded
construction.complete_model_only_when: status MODEL_CONSTRUCTED and successful build_model return

budget.clock_origin: before input read; imports excluded for all methods
budget.execution_stop: cooperative checkpoints, not a hard real-time process stop
budget.evidence_cutoff: one absolute monotonic deadline; no round reset
